limitations: Artifact identity is unavailable for this observation.
The target operating system and architecture were not reported by this observation.
QWidget grab is a controlled raster, not physical display/presented proof.
Histograms and candidate colors are sampled output scalars, not the internal QPainter pen or full terminal style state.

Only the five fixed sources and one grab per phase are covered. Structural failure stops; offline color ties, nonuniform backgrounds or missing ink remain unknown without shifted ROI, additional grab or retry.
Same-frame raw signatures may alias or differ. Nonunique or empty matches stay null and never establish reset or full style; no dominant-color tie breaks are used.
Telnet direct-terminal observations do not establish WinPTY/ConPTY local-shell behavior or resolve margins.
45seconds is capture duration and60seconds is CLI wait timeout; target starts before a separate2-second delay and cleanup follows. No whole-lifecycle bound or performance conclusion.
Raw image/ROI pixels, paths, PIDs, copied original resources and profile stay local; only audited color/size scalars and hashes are published.
Provider subject/environment may remain null. Preparation enforces full module/package hashes and the injected script checks actual module paths and exact export RVAs.
Owned launcher deliberately terminates the original GUI; Job active0 is cleanup, not natural-exit proof.
